name: Ak Bars Bank
note: Official bank of FC Rubin; name on the upper front and logo patch on the sleeve of the 2026-27 home shirt (official club store product photos, 2026-10-03). The largest shareholders per Cbonds' profile are Tatarstan state bodies and companies (over 50% combined); single-sourced — the bank's own site (akbars.ru) and e-disclosure block scripted access, so no second source obtained.
